beats.say: Sometimes the trap has no link and no file. Just an urgent money request in your manager's name.
The name is familiar, but the address is not the agency's. Anyone can type any sender name.

body.text: Hello Sabina,
We need to transfer 18,400 AZN to a partner today before 16:00.
Do not tell anyone yet, the talks are confidential.
I am in a meeting, do not call, just write.
The bank details are attached.

beats.say: The demand for secrecy and the ban on calls are there to stop you from checking.

body.text: Hello Sabina,
We need to transfer 18,400 AZN to a partner today before 16:00.
Do not tell anyone yet, the talks are confidential.
I am in a meeting, do not call, just write.
The bank details are attached.

beats.say: Always check money or bank detail requests another way. Call a number you already know yourself.

checkpoint.prompt: What if it comes from the director's real address?

options.label: Then there is no need to check
options.feedback: The mailbox may have been hacked. Always check money requests by phone.

options.label: I still check by phone
options.feedback: Right. A real address can be stolen too.

scenes.prompt: Find the signs: the real supplier writes from ofistechizat.az.

body.text: Dear colleagues,
Because we have changed banks,
please send payments to the new account from this month.
Do not pay the old account, the money will bounce.
Pay the September invoice this week to avoid a penalty.

spots.label: Look-alike address
spots.explain: The real address is ofistechizat.az. A hyphen has been added here.

spots.label: New account
spots.explain: Changed bank details are the classic form of this fraud. Always check on the number in the contract.

spots.label: Old account ban
spots.explain: Banning the old account pushes you to the new one without checking.

spots.label: Penalty pressure
spots.explain: Fear of a penalty makes you rush. Pressure is exactly the reason to check.

scenes.title: Your turn
scenes.body: Friday, 15:05. You are alone in accounting, and payments must go out by 16:00.

scenes.title: A supplier calls
scenes.intro: Right after the bank details email, your phone rings. Listen to the caller and decide.

actions.label: Answer
actions.feedback: Answering is not dangerous. What matters is what you agree to.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: That works too. Before paying, call the supplier yourself on the number in the contract.

steps.say: Hello, Gunel Aliyeva from OfisTəchizat. Did you get our email? Please pay the September invoice to the new account today.
steps.spoken: Hello, <breath> Gunel Aliyeva from OfisTəchizat. Did you get our email? Please pay the September invoice, uh, to the new account today.

actions.label: Fine, I will pay today
actions.feedback: The call repeats the email's story; it proves nothing. Confirm bank changes on the contract number.

actions.label: I will check on the contract number
actions.feedback: Right: the email and the call can come from the same scammer. Check through another channel.

steps.say: There is no time, our director is upset. If you want to check, just call me back on this number.
steps.spoken: There is no time, <breath> our director is upset. If you want to check, just call me back on this number.

actions.label: Hang up
actions.feedback: Right. When the pressure grows, end the call politely and check for yourself.

actions.label: I will call this number to confirm
actions.feedback: A number the caller gives you is her own phone. Trust only the number in the contract.

steps.label: The call has ended. What do you do now?

actions.label: Call the number in the contract
actions.feedback: Right. Dial the official number yourself, ideally from another phone.

actions.label: Do nothing, just do not pay
actions.feedback: The money is safe, but the supplier and colleagues stay unaware. The scammer will try someone else.

steps.label: Calling the contract number
steps.say: OfisTəchizat, Gunel Aliyeva speaking. No, we have not changed our bank details or called you.
steps.spoken: OfisTəchizat, <breath> Gunel Aliyeva speaking. No, we have, uh, not changed our bank details or called you.

actions.label: Tell accounting and security
actions.feedback: Great. Report the email without deleting it: the team blocks the fake domain and warns colleagues.

actions.label: I did not pay, that is enough
actions.feedback: The money is safe, but the same email may reach colleagues. Reporting protects them.

scenes.prompt: Is this request safe or a threat?

body.text: Hi, this is my new number.
Urgently buy five 200 manat gift cards and send me the codes. I will pay you back.

cards.explain: A new number plus gift cards is a classic scam. Call your manager's old number to check.

body.text: Sabina, please bring the quarterly report to tomorrow's meeting. Thanks.

cards.explain: The right address and a normal work request. No money and no secrecy.

messages.text: Hi, it is Rauf Karimov, my phone is broken. Urgently transfer 3,000 AZN to a partner, I emailed the details.

cards.explain: An unknown number, a broken phone excuse and urgent money. Call the director's number that you know.

body.text: Hello. The September invoice is attached. Payment goes to the account in the contract, as usual.

cards.explain: A known address, an expected invoice and no change of bank details. A normal email.

body.text: Transfer 9,750 AZN to a new partner today, details below.
Do not call, I am in a meeting.

cards.explain: The address is real, but the mailbox may be hacked. Urgent money plus a ban on calls is reason enough to check.

body.text: Sabina, I sent tomorrow's payment documents for approval in the system. Have a look when you can.

cards.explain: A normal process: payments are approved in the official system by the rules. Nothing is rushed.

scenes.prompt: Put the steps for a suspicious money request in order.

items.label: Check on a number you know
If it is fake, press Report phishing

scenes.explain: Pause, check, then report. No Report phishing button? Forward it to IT security. If you already paid, call your bank and IT security at once.

points: Check money and bank detail requests another way.
Urgency plus secrecy is the signature of fraud.
Do not delete, press Report phishing.
